source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: An arrangement of k out of n is an ordered choice: Aₙᵏ = n(n − 1)...(n − k + 1) = n!/(n − k)!.
stages.headlineEnglish: An arrangement of k out of n is an ordered choice: Aₙᵏ = n(n − 1)...(n − k + 1) = n!/(n − k)!.

stages.headline: A combination of k out of n is a choice without order: Cₙᵏ = Aₙᵏ/k! = n!/(k!(n − k)!).
stages.headlineEnglish: A combination of k out of n is a choice without order: Cₙᵏ = Aₙᵏ/k! = n!/(k!(n − k)!).

stages.headline: Order matters: arrangement; it does not: combination. President and secretary from 5: 20; a committee of 2: 10.
stages.headlineEnglish: Order matters: arrangement; it does not: combination. President and secretary from 5: 20; a committee of 2: 10.
